description: This source file implements a command-line tool 'symupload' for uploading executable/dll symbols and associated data to an HTTP server, specifically for Windows platforms. It includes functions for extracting version info, creating temporary symbol files, and handling HTTP requests, along with main logic for argument parsing and upload process.

classes.name: google_breakpad::PDBSourceLineWriter
classes.description: Handles extraction and writing of symbol data from PE files and PDBs.

classes.name: google_breakpad::HTTPUpload
classes.description: Facilitates HTTP requests for uploading symbol data.

methods.name: GetFileVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of a specified file.

methods.name: DumpSymbolsToTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file containing symbol data extracted from a PE file.
